$comment: openspec/changes/leaf-integrations. Declares the Mail-sidebar intake and the calendar planning leaf on the publication schema. The mail template maps only title, summary and description: it never sets publicationDate, depublicationDate, status, organization, themes or a retention field, so a publication created from an email is a draft the public cannot read until an editor publishes it (REQ-002). The organization leaves of this change are not declared here: the organization schema is OpenRegister's shared one, not part of this register.
